description: Every nonempty model of a monadic sentence \(\varphi\) has an induced nonempty finite submodel of size at most \(\max(1,q(\varphi))2^k\) satisfying the same sentence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.small_submodel.{u_1} {k : ℕ} {M : Type u_1}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Structure M] [Nonempty M]
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Sentence) (hφ : M ⊨ φ) :
  ∃ D, D.Nonempty ∧ D.card ≤ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.bound φ ∧ ↥D ⊨ φ
